why: Only Coverr nail clip that fits the beauty art direction: tight macro of a brush laying nude-mauve polish on a nail against a soft cream-white backdrop, locked-off and calm with no faces, logos, labels or text. Bright and warm like the beauty poster, so the template's #ead6c4 multiply grade and brown gradients turn it champagne. The hands sit centre-right (nail at x~0.58), which leaves the lower left for the headline. Cut 1.96-10.84 s of the source, 8.28 s with a 0.6 s crossfade to its own start; seam diff 0.66 vs a median frame step of 0.44
